# Sovereign Website

> An independent brochure about Sovereign Website: websites built by a team of AI agents and owned by the people they are for, from its own public pages.

This file is for AI agents and the people using them. The site is https://sovereign-website.startups.sovereignweb.site/, static files in the public repository https://github.com/SovereignWebsite/Site__Startups__Sovereign-Website (served from site/ on the dev branch). Pick the section that matches who you are acting for, read it in full, then follow it.

## If you act for a visitor (read-only)

- Read the site's pages, starting at https://sovereign-website.startups.sovereignweb.site/.
- Answer from what the site says, with a link for each point. When the site does not say something, say so plainly; never fill the gap with a guess.
- Do not change anything.

## If you act for the site's owner

- The owner changes the site through the repository. You need write access, which the owner gets by accepting the repository invitation: https://sovereign-website.startups.sovereignweb.site/start/
- Work on the dev branch only; main is locked. Read the repository's CLAUDE.md first and follow it.
- Keep the site static: no server code, no cookies, no tracking. Never invent a fact, a price or a customer.
- Every push to dev publishes the site in a minute or two.

## More

- Use this site with AI: https://sovereign-website.startups.sovereignweb.site/agents/
- Start here (for the owner): https://sovereign-website.startups.sovereignweb.site/start/
- How this site was made: https://sovereign-website.startups.sovereignweb.site/admin/
- The agents that work on this site: https://sovereign-website.startups.sovereignweb.site/data/agents.json

An independent brochure about Sovereign Website, made from its own public pages. Official site: https://sovereignwebsite.ai/
